description: Change a formatting rule that exists: its name, the fields it styles, the style, the rows it applies to. settings are MERGED into the style it has (pass only what changes: «make it bold too» keeps its colour); conditions is the whole list of row conditions it keeps.

all.description: true = every row; false = only the rows that match conditions

conditions.description: The whole list: property_id (a field), condition (is, is_not, contains, is_empty, less_than, greater_than …), search, join (and / or)

property_ids.description: Names or ids of the fields the style applies to (empty = every column)

settings.description: background_color (#hex), text_color (#hex), bold, italic, underline, strike (boolean), font_family, font_size (px), all_columns (boolean)

name: update_formatting
